full_judgment: 17. The learned Advocate submitted that the patta dated 3-3-1956 is a document of more than 30 years old and has been produced by the plaintiff as contemplated under section 90 of the evidence Act and which has got presumption of genuineness of the document and having regard to such evidence on record the Courts below decreed the suit and committed to error of law in decreeing the suit. The learned Advocate has referred the case of Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) vs Md Reasuddin Pk reported in 5 BLC (AD) 76.
